extracted.name: Roast cauliflower cheese pizza
extracted.description: Serve this simple cauliflower cheese pizza alongside plenty of salad for a wholesome meal. It's a brilliant vegetarian supper the whole family will love
ingredient_lines: 1 large cauliflower trimmed and broken into small florets, stalk chopped
1 thin 25cm pizza base or 2 small pizza bases
instruction_lines: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Mix the oil and garlic, then toss the cauliflower in it. Tip onto a baking sheet and roast for 30-45 mins until the edges have browned a little and the cauliflower is tender.

Spread half the mascarpone on the pizza base (or bases) and season well. Scatter over the cauliflower and dot over the remaining mascarpone, then sprinkle with the cheese. Bake for 20 mins, then cool for 5 mins before serving.
